description: Starts an empty DIYA-GL book for a new business (the product's starting accounts, the twelve months to the year end and that year's tax rates) and saves it in the person's DIY Accounting Submit account as a new book, which becomes the open one. Use this when the person starts keeping their records for a new business. It changes no other DIYA-GL book and does not file anything.

clientId.description: A practice client's id, to keep the DIYA-GL book in that client's set

product.description: bst (Basic Sole Trader), taxi (Taxi Driver), se (Self Employed) or ltd (Limited Company)

vatRegistered.description: se and ltd only: the business is VAT registered

yearEnd.description: The last day of the first accounting year, YYYY-MM-DD

name: new_book
title: Start a new DIYA-GL book
